name: Gragas
notes: Opening: Explosive Cask (R) is cast at t=0 and keeps Gragas busy for its 0.25 s cast time (no other cast or attack starts before it ends); it then impacts 0.5 s after that.

Barrel Roll (Q) is thrown right after the opener and again on cooldown. Its throw has a 0.25 s cast time (gen.Q.castTimeS), during which no other cast or attack starts; the cask's own travel to the target location is not given a value in the sources and is treated as landing immediately once the cast ends, the same convention used for other short, untimed travel.

Barrel Roll is always held for its full 2 s fermentation before being manually detonated: every rank's cooldown (10-6 s) is longer than 2 s, so waiting for the 150% maximum damage and slow costs no extra casts over the fight. Detonation therefore always uses the kit's precomputed maximum-damage numbers (the wiki's tooltip-only 150%-of-minimum values). The detonation itself has no cast time, but still waits for any cast in progress.

Only the initial Barrel Roll cast counts as an ability activation for on-cast effects (e.g. Spellblade); the wiki states the manual recast/detonation explicitly does not, so Spellblade is primed on the throw only.

Drunken Rage (W) is cast on cooldown, waiting for any cast in progress even though it has no cast time of its own. Its 0.75 s channel holds the next attack; the resulting empowered attack (bonus magic damage: base + 70% AP + 7% of the target's max health) is applied on the very next basic attack after the channel ends, and can crit as the wiki states. Its cooldown starts post-effect, i.e. after the channel plus the 2.5 s damage-reduction duration, matching the wiki's 'starts post-effect' note.

Body Slam (E) is cast on cooldown, waiting for any cast in progress even though it has no cast time of its own; its short dash-to-collision is treated as instant, like other untimed dashes. It always connects with the stationary dummy, so its current cooldown is always cut by 40% immediately on cast.
Damage reduction from W, and the slow/stun/knockback from Q/E/R, do nothing in this fight (the dummy never attacks or needs to be displaced) and are not modeled.
Happy Hour's self-heal is not modeled: it deals no damage and healing has no effect on a damage fight.
Mana is not modeled: nothing here binds inside a 15 s fight at level 16.
maxOrder Q > E > W: Q and E gain the most damage and cooldown per rank; W's cooldown is rank-independent, so it is maxed last.
Between casts Gragas fills time with basic attacks.

assumed.why: the cask's travel time to the target location is not given a number in the sources; assumed instant/negligible like other short, untimed travel.
